description: Search Talent.com's local sites, replay saved search URLs, fetch individual job pages, or look up salary statistics. No account, cookie or API key is needed.

companyName.description: Only return jobs matching this employer name (mode=search). Works on the United States, Canada and United Kingdom sites; Talent.com ignores it elsewhere, so the actor does too.
companyName.sectionDescription: Talent.com supports different filters per country. Unsupported combinations are skipped with a warning instead of returning zero jobs.
companyName.title: Company name filter

country.description: Which local Talent.com site to use. Each country is a separate job index with its own listings, currency and language. Canada and Russia sites may block non-local networks.
country.title: Country site

datePosted.description: Only return jobs found within this many days (mode=search). Leave empty for any time.
datePosted.title: Date posted

descriptionMaxLength.description: Truncate plain-text descriptions to this many characters (0 = no limit). Applies to descriptions and snippets.
descriptionMaxLength.title: Max description length

fetchFullDescriptions.description: Open each job page during a search to fill the full description when the search page only has a snippet (mode=search or bySearchUrls). Adds one request per job.
fetchFullDescriptions.sectionDescription: Control volume, description length and optional detail enrichment.
fetchFullDescriptions.title: Fetch full descriptions

jobType.description: Only return jobs of this employment type (mode=search). Supported on the United States, Canada and United Kingdom sites only; ignored elsewhere with a warning.
jobType.title: Job type

jobUrls.description: Talent.com job page URLs or numeric job ids (mode=byJobUrls). Example: https://www.talent.com/view?id=626159695573821803. Job ids are scoped to their country site; the URL's own host wins.
jobUrls.title: Job URLs or ids

keyword.description: A single job title or keyword (mode=search or salary). Example: "software engineer", "nurse", "warehouse". Combined with Search keywords when both are set.
keyword.title: Job keyword / title

location.description: City, state, or region (mode=search or salary). Example: "New York, NY", "London", "Toronto". Leave empty to search all locations. Location text is matched loosely, like the site's own search box.
location.title: Location

maxItems.description: Maximum number of job or salary records to return across all searches and URLs.
maxItems.title: Max results

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages per search (mode=search or bySearchUrls). Talent.com shows about 20 jobs per page and stops after a few pages per query.
maxPages.title: Max pages per search

mode.description: What to collect: job search results, saved search URLs, individual job pages, or salary statistics.
enumTitles: Search jobs by keyword and location
Fetch job details by URL or id
mode.title: Mode

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. The actor requests directly first and only uses this proxy after a block or rate-limit. The free AUTO datacenter group is enough; no paid proxy is required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

quickApplyOnly.description: Only return jobs with Talent.com's one-click Quick Apply (mode=search). Supported on the same country sites as Remote only; ignored elsewhere with a warning.
quickApplyOnly.title: Quick Apply only

radiusMiles.description: Search radius around the location, in miles (mode=search). Mapped to Talent.com's supported distance stops: 2, 5, 10, 15, 30 or 60 miles (nearest stop).
radiusMiles.title: Distance (miles)

remoteOnly.description: Only return remote/work-from-home jobs (mode=search). Supported on ca, www (US), uk, in, ch, es, nl, it, de and fr sites; ignored elsewhere with a warning.
remoteOnly.title: Remote only

searchQueries.description: One or more job titles or keywords (mode=search or salary). Each query runs as its own search; results are deduplicated by job id. The legacy single 'keyword' field is combined with this list.
searchQueries.sectionDescription: Used by mode=search and mode=salary. Set a keyword and/or a location.
searchQueries.title: Search keywords

searchUrls.description: Talent.com search or category URLs to replay (mode=bySearchUrls). Examples: https://www.talent.com/jobs?k=nurse&l=London or https://uk.talent.com/jobs/k-nurse-l-london. Unsupported filters in a pasted URL are removed.
searchUrls.sectionDescription: Use these modes to replay saved searches or collect specific job pages without retyping filters.
searchUrls.title: Search URLs

title: Talent.com Jobs and Salary Scraper input
